title: Nasa’s SpaceX Crew-10 Participate In Pre-Departure News Conference – Friday, July 25, 2025
description: Aboard the International Space Station NASA astronauts Anne McClain and Nichole Ayers as well as JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) astronaut Takuya Onishi and Roscosmos cosmonaut Kirill Peskov gave remarks about their mission during a news conference July 25. The Crew-10 astronauts will return to Earth via a parachute assisted splashdown off the coast of California. The four crew members have been living and working aboard the microgravity laboratory to advance scientific knowledge and demonstrate new technologies for future human and robotic exploration flights as part of NASA’s Moon and Mars exploration approach, including lunar missions through NASA’s Artemis program.    Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: https://www.nasa.gov/subscribe
